summary: Submitted a convergence test for the one lagging node seen after the reconfiguration stress: same seed and reconfigure step, but 150 fair-delivery rounds instead of 40 so the default 100-tick resend timeout can fire. The run emits converged_all (all decided indices equal) and checks it, gated on progressed and reconfigured, alongside the retained agreement predicate. This distinguishes the expected resend-interval lag from a bounded liveness defect; all existing findings remain unchanged.
